Multilingual Programs

Dual Language

SBISD is committed to developing bilingual and biliterate students through Dual Language Education. We offer Two-Way and One-Way programs at designated campuses, providing students with opportunities to develop language proficiency, achieve academic success and build an appreciation for diverse cultures. Both programs follow a 50/50 instructional approach, with instruction delivered in Spanish and English.
